name: Asset Allocation - Broad Portfolio Calculator
meta_description: Test a nine-class portfolio mix with your own hypothetical returns and volatility. See blended risk and return, drift from target and a rebalancing table.
subtitle: Split a portfolio across nine asset classes, from US and international stocks to bonds, real estate and cash, and see the hypothetical return and volatility of your current and target mixes plus the trades to rebalance.

card.fields_html:
Your holdings and assumptions

Enter what you hold in each asset class and the target mix you want to test. Return and volatility figures are hypothetical assumptions you choose, not forecasts. Volatility is the typical yearly swing (standard deviation) around the return.
